terminology: CT Abdomen: the CPT codes for existing CT Abdomen studies are IMGCT0491 or IMGIL0001.
CT Abdomen/Pelvis with IV contrast: the CPT code is 74177.
Heart rate: the code for heart rate is 'HEARTRATE'.
Urinary catheter: the procedure code for urinary catheter is 'NUR1373'.
Malignant neoplasm of left kidney: the ICD-10 code is C64.2.
Interventional Radiology referral: the CPT code is CON417.
TSH: the code for TSH is 'TSH'.
Free T4: the code for free T4 is 'FT4'.
QTc interval: the code for QTc interval is 'QTCINTERVAL'.
12-lead ECG: the SNOMED code for 12-lead ECG is 445118002.
Influenza vaccine: the CPT code for influenza vaccine is 90686.
COVID-19 vaccine: the code for COVID-19 vaccine procedure is 'COVIDVACCINE'; COVID-19 vaccines are also recorded as MedicationRequest with text containing 'COVID-19 VAC'.
COVID vaccine booster: the CPT code for the single-dose COVID vaccine is 91320.
Opioid analgesic medications: hydromorphone, oxycodone, fentanyl, hydrocodone, morphine.
QT-prolonging medications: text containing ondansetron, prochlorperazine and most antipsychotic medications.
Anticoagulant medications: any anti-coagulant medication (for example, LMWH, DOAC, etc), including heparin.
